frustrated_triangle.stimulus: Three equal-length canonical directions forming a rotated equilateral triangle through the origin; each menu contains a direction and its negative. Cross all eight possible stable value assignments. Every item is physically experienced before an independent action on each is read.
frustrated_triangle.logic: If a single stored three-vector determines the antisymmetric motor margin by dot product, the margins of the three canonical directions sum to zero. It cannot make all three strictly positive for +++ and all three strictly negative for --- in their respective histories. Paired success on both opposing histories at a positive margin is a more demanding test than pooled accuracy.
frustrated_triangle.diagnostic: Compare effective responses to a single change of taste history, separate own-label effects, other labels and higher-order interactions; regress feedback-induced margin variation onto observed similarity and presentation order on heldout geometries. A good surrogate alone does not establish the network algorithm.

review_noise: Under a stable private law, wrong taste slips occur at 0%, 20%, or 35% independently. Compare real actions to the public empirical majority and its stationary attainable accuracy. In a separate matched test preserve the counts of positive/negative evidence but reverse order.
credit_stability: Long-life full-gradient norms grew by several orders of magnitude at unchanged graph size. A faithful forward control compares true full differentiation, hidden-only cut, graph-only cut, and full pathwise cut at block boundaries. Discrete motor and edit decisions always receive the full causal reward-to-go.
rule_only_outer_search: Supplementary optimizer test starts all methods at the same uniform-query specialist. Inherited body and topology are initially identical and fixed only in the outer rule-refinement comparison. Inside lives, the complete physical graph can always write weights, biases and connectivity. Compare antithetic perturbations of the inherited learning rule to full and truncated REINFORCE with the same number of physical lives and actual earned resources.
